# 張方燡 Pete（Fang-I (Pete) Zhang）

> I turn ambiguous business questions into testable hypotheses, then answer them with data. MS candidate, National Taiwan University · Digital & Data Intern, BNP Paribas Cardif TCB Life. Actively seeking roles in commercial planning, data analytics, and strategy.

把模糊的商業問題，拆成可以驗證的假設，再用數據給出答案。 臺大農業經濟學研究所碩士生｜合庫人壽 數位與數據部實習生。積極尋找商業企劃、數據分析與策略相關職缺。

- Now: MS, National Taiwan University (expected Jun 2027)
- Interning at: BNP Paribas Cardif TCB Life, Digital & Data
- Research: Applied machine learning, applied econometrics, causal inference, financial risk models
- Languages: Mandarin (native), English (professional working proficiency)

## Work / 作品（public summaries; full write-ups on request）
- [Life insurance digital channel: priority segments and opportunity sizing｜壽險數位通路：找出優先客群並估算商機](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/cardif/): BNP Paribas Cardif TCB Life Insurance, 2026.07 –, Ongoing. Without a traditional agent force, I used issue trees, SQL and XGBoost to find 3 priority segments and sized the digital-channel opportunity with a three-scenario funnel.
- [This site: personal profile × bilingual data-science knowledge base × AI model radar｜本站：個人介紹 × 雙語資料科學知識庫 × AI 模型雷達](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/site/): Personal project, 2026.09, Live. Organized 143 ML, statistics and causal methods into two MECE knowledge trees, each explained plain-language first and math last, and wrote a scoring model that picks the most interesting Hugging Face models every day.
- [Hot-pot chain: from discount-driven visits to lifecycle membership｜連鎖火鍋品牌：從折價驅動轉向會員生命週期經營](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/laowang/): Laowang Hot Pot × TMBA industry–academia project, 2026.07 – 2026.08, 3rd place. Led 8 people through 4 sprints in one month: consolidated members into 5 lifecycle tiers with RFM, designed a phased strategy for off-peak capacity and member relationships, and the framework was adopted into the client's CRM planning.
- [E.SUN Origin: an interactive financial diary for Gen Z｜玉山 Origin：給 Z 世代的互動式金融日記](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/esun/): E.SUN Bank business plan competition, 2025.12, Business plan. A subscription bookkeeping service for students and new graduates who are just starting to manage money: automatic logging, LLM chat logging and an annual Wrapped, with a free student plan that builds the habit, then converts to paid and feeds the E.SUN ecosystem.
- [New credit card: finding the growth lever with an issue tree and hypothesis tests｜新信用卡：用議題樹與假設檢定找出成長槓桿](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/citi/): TMBA Business Strategy (Citi case), 2025.06 – 2025.08, 2nd place. Split total spend into average spend and transaction count, targeted top spenders in the department-store occasion, and used one-sample t-tests on 291 survey responses to show tiered rewards are the strongest lever.
- [Summer project internship: turning a cold list into attending companies｜暑期專案實習：把陌生名單變成出席的企業客戶](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/riverbien/): RiverBien Consulting Firm, 2025.06 – 2025.08, ≈33% conversion. Supported the firm's flagship seminar end to end, turning 300+ cold outbound touchpoints into 100+ registered organizations and securing C-suite guests.
- [Data preprocessing pipeline: five steps from raw data to model-ready features｜資料前處理工作流：五個步驟把原始資料整理成可建模的特徵](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/prep/): Personal project · GitHub, 2026.06, Practice. Turned the data-cleaning habits from my projects into five Python scripts (inspection, missing values, outliers and duplicates, transformation, scaling), with the reasoning behind each step written down.
- [Local RAG: a Q&A knowledge base built on momentum-strategy papers｜本地 RAG：用動能策略文獻建一個可以問答的知識庫](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/ragquant/): Personal project · GitHub, 2025.08, Practice. A local RAG built with LangChain, FAISS and Ollama: 5 Taiwanese and international momentum-strategy papers are chunked and embedded, and each question retrieves the most relevant passages for a local model to answer, with sources listed.
- [US ETF momentum backtest: 12-1 momentum, top 3｜美國 ETF 動能策略回測：12-1 動能挑前 3 檔](https://p1t1rzhang.github.io/work/etfmom/): Personal project · GitHub, 2025.08, Practice. A Python backtest of 12-1 momentum across 8 US ETFs: hold the top 3 equally weighted, rebalance on a schedule, include trading costs, and compare returns, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown and beta against SPY.
